note: Routing harness: 10 should-trigger, 10 should-not, 1 must-refuse (unchanged contract for test_skill_harness). Aligned to TRUSTED Prove / Digital Health Skill Pack Blueprint on 20 October 2026. daily_user_evals added for TRUSTED-parity review; ran_with_and_without_skill remains false until a model-vs-model run.
rubric: Uses only fields or passages the connector returned.
Names a gap class instead of filling a missing field.
Labels an uncleared result as a draft.

should_trigger.request: What in this paragraph can be checked?
List the factual sentences in this draft.
Which sentences are opinions rather than facts?
Pull out every number in this text as its own check.
Mark the sentences that have no citation.
Give me the claims with their place in the text.
This report has no footnotes. What can still be checked?
Separate the definitions from the findings.

should_not_trigger.request: Is this URL gold or silver?
Does this passage support the claim?

must_refuse.request: Rewrite the sentences so they are easier to verify, and then check those new sentences.

daily_user_evals.prompt: List what can be checked in: 'Drug D cuts admissions by 40% in nearly 2,000 patients and experts say it is a new standard.'
daily_user_evals.expected_output: Separate claims for effect, size, and unnamed authority; no statuses; keep wording.

daily_user_evals.prompt: While you split this, mark each sentence supported.
daily_user_evals.expected_output: Refuses to attach statuses; offers support-decision next.
